title: Validate docs content consistency and homepage discoverability
description: Run validation, fix docs inventory/content consistency issues, and ensure homepage/sidebar discover the new guides pages.
action: Run npm --prefix docs-site run build. If docs lint fails, update inventory.ts/content-guides.ts/content.ts so every docPages id has one content entry and no orphan content exists. Verify LandingPage contains links to guides pages and featuredDocs references valid doc page ids.

convergence.definition_of_done: Docs-site builds successfully and new guide pages are reachable through navigation and homepage links.

files.change: Fix any missing/invalid docs navigation entries.
Fix missing or malformed content entries.
Ensure new guide pages are discoverable.

implementation: Run npm --prefix docs-site run build and capture failures.
If docs lint reports missing content, add the missing key to guidesContent or remove invalid docPages entry.
If TypeScript reports invalid featuredDocs ids, adjust ids to existing docPages ids.
Optionally use Chrome DevTools to inspect homepage and one guides page after build if dev server is started.

rationale.chosen_approach: A final validation task catches navigation/content drift after parallel content edits.
rationale.tradeoffs: Validation task depends on all content tasks.

risks: Existing unrelated working tree changes may remain; do not include them in docs validation fixes.
